name: KOI Ext - Scheduled Hunt Sweep
details: Time-triggered proactive hunt sweep. Runs the KOI Ext - Hunt Sweep playbook on a schedule: executes the configured hunting XQL queries, investigates every match, posts a war-room summary, and routes confirmed ungoverned known-bad to an analyst-gated block (auto_block is always false). This is a SCHEDULED job, not a feed or event trigger - a scheduled sweep has no triggering event, so it is a Job rather than a correlation rule. Requires the Cortex XDR - XQL Query Engine integration (the playbook degrades gracefully if it is absent) and a configured KOI instance. Adjust the cadence and, if needed, override the playbook inputs (hunt_set, xql_time_frame, enable_response_gate) on this job. REVIEW BEFORE ENABLING in a shared environment - each run opens an investigation and posts a summary.
description: Scheduled proactive KOI supply-chain hunt sweep (runs KOI Ext - Hunt Sweep).
